sentences.text: IPMA has issued a yellow warning for rain in the Lisboa district, from 12:00 to 18:00 local time today, 2026-11-21.
Today in Lisboa, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 14.3 °C and a maximum of 19 °C, with a 100% chance of rain and a moderate wind from the S.
Tomorrow, 2026-11-22, IPMA forecasts a minimum of 11.1 °C and a maximum of 17.6 °C in Lisboa, with a 0% chance of rain and a weak wind from the NW.
The IPMA sea forecast for the Lisboa coast on 2026-11-22 gives waves of 2 to 2.4 metres from the NW and a sea temperature of 17.7 to 17.8 °C.
